decision_consistency: STAGE_BLOCKED_SOURCE_DESIGN_NOT_ESTABLISHED / RETAIN_K1402 is supported by the absence of a completed distribution/contact/380-GH network/carrier construction. It is not a demonstrated source infeasibility or geometric impossibility. Preserve all positive short-feed and conditional parallel-return evidence.
mandatory_scope_limits: Sample minima are upper bounds on the minimum continuous clearance. They cannot be reported as positive clearance lower certificates along unsampled curve portions or between travel poses. No witnessed conflict is the supported conclusion.
Nominal gap samples20.4,25.4,30.5mm do not cover full tolerance gap20.2..30.7mm. C0 position, C1/C2 shape and datum/thermal/process allocations are not applied by this witness.

The source-height boxes are reservation models; an overlap would reject that reservation construction, not prove exact physical solids collide. Conversely, this obstacle set is not a complete hardware inventory.

No revised carrier/arms/collets/fasteners or load path is checked. No board slab/edge penetration or full enclosure Z-wall test is performed. Land/bridge termination cutback, solder, stripping and dielectric geometry remain uninstantiated.
The fixed support/tool/loom columns conservatively span Z[-160,-90] but do not model a complete moving service assembly or prove all100 trimmer access paths.

The result does not establish manufactured fixed-length wire equilibrium, termination current-field compatibility, copper resistance, all owned feed closure, or the complete380-GH coupled return network.
The baseline review suggestion to complete a source candidate is an available next design route, not a claim that the carrier/contact/copper construction is already feasible.
recommended_packet_wording: No counterexample was found among the saved samples at three nominal travel poses. The58mm/66mm family remains a conditional design alternative. The joined stage is blocked because a complete source design with carrier, finite contacts, owned distribution and coupled return certificate has not been established; retainK1402 without declaring the alternative impossible.
review_execution: Independent code and saved-output review; no rerun of witness, curve solve, pose evaluation, sweep, native or routing. Only source hashes and 63 saved-witness distance identities recomputed.
